synthesis: Adds the 'Missed Opportunities' compact stat card to the Company Metrics grid at row 3 col 3 (between Total Repossessions and LPR Recovery Leaderboard in CompanyMetricsOverview::cards()), and separately fixes a grain bug in the pre-existing, currently-orphaned MissedOpportunityClientGraph. The card counts distinct missed-opportunity hotlists (countDistinct(hotlist_id), never a raw row count) for the viewing org's hotlist_org_id over the page date filter, gated behind FeatureEnum::MISSED_OPPORTUNITY. Cheap table (595k rows) with hotlist_org_id as the ClickHouse sort-key prefix, so no batching warranted. The graph fix corrects a bypass of the model's own scopes: MissedOpportunityClientGraph::clients() uses raw count() per client instead of the countDistinct(hotlist_id) every other consumer and all 4 model scopes use.

claims_to_corroborate.claim: The 'grain fix' IS: MissedOpportunityClientGraph::clients() selectRaw('client_org_name, count() as total') should be countDistinct(hotlist_id). count() counts missed-opportunity EVENT rows; the rest of the family counts DISTINCT hotlist_id (vehicles, not events).
claims_to_corroborate.corroboration: reference impl diff at the sibling-card epic's reference branch made the same change and recorded a 2.76x-4.28x reduction across 5 orgs

claims_to_corroborate.claim: MissedOpportunityClientGraph is currently DEAD CODE - not reachable from any page/panel. Its old usage in Dashboard::getFooterWidgets() was commented out during the dashboard rebuild and never re-added.
claims_to_corroborate.evidence_cited: rg across repo finds references only in its own file, RendersDashboardStat docblock mentions, and two okf pages; git log -S locates the commenting-out commit

claims_to_corroborate.claim: FINAL / ->final() is NOT required on this aggregate. countDistinct(hotlist_id) is immune to surplus unmerged ReplacingMergeTree versions (duplicate rows of the same id carry the same hotlist_id), and the FilterDeletedRecords global scope already applies _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 to every query. All 4 existing model scopes already omit ->final().
The org axis is hotlist_org_id. Table ORDER BY is (hotlist_org_id, toYYYYMM(scanned_at), scanned_at, id), so per-org scoping prunes efficiently - no sort-key-pruning gotcha like the hits tables.
claims_to_corroborate.evidence_cited: database/schema/clickhouse-schema.sql:31; okf/concepts/missed-opportunity.md ('Scope by hotlist_org_id, not org_id... getting this backwards is the classic missed-opportunity bug'); model scopeForOrg()

claims_to_corroborate.claim: GUEST-SAFETY TRAP: canViewCardData() must short-circuit 'if (auth()->guest()) return true;' BEFORE calling Feature::active(). PennantServiceProvider defines MISSED_OPPORTUNITY as fn (User $user) with a NON-NULLABLE User param; ArrayDriver::resolveValue() invokes the resolver directly with no type guard; the default scope resolver returns auth()->guard()->user() = null for a guest -> TypeError. Dashboard::cardWidgets()/expandableCards() ARE reachable unauthenticated. The closed reference impl used auth()->check() && (...) which returns FALSE for guests - that breaks the existing guest-parity test (array_keys(cards()) === array_keys(expandableCards()) for a guest), whereas returning TRUE needs no test change.
claims_to_corroborate.note: HIGHEST-VALUE claim to corroborate independently - it asserts the reference implementation got this backwards.

claims_to_corroborate.claim: A SECOND test file breaks that the ticket does not name: tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/Concerns/DashboardCardVisibilityTest.php. Its docblock states 'No production card is gated yet' and test_every_real_card_is_ungated_and_therefore_expandable() asserts that invariant in a loop over ALL of cards(). This card is the FIRST real Pro-gated card, so the loop breaks. Also assertCount(7, CompanyMetricsOverview::cards()) at :44-64 must become 8.

No new App\Clickhouse\Queries\* class is needed. The card can be built entirely on the existing Eloquent App\Clickhouse\Models\MissedOpportunity + scopeSelectTotal(), which resolves its database via the model's clarity_clickhouse connection binding (config-driven), never an interpolated 'clarity.' string - so the hardcoded-prefix defect class cannot occur in this design at all.

getStatColor() must NOT map this card to 'gray' - lockedStat() already hardcodes 'gray' for the withheld state, so reusing it would make an unlocked card visually identical to a locked one. 'primary' was the one named Filament color not yet used by a sibling arm.

cards() currently has 7 entries; the new key goes between 'recovery-counts' and 'recovery-leader' because row 3 reads [blank][blank][Missed Opportunities][LPR Recovery Leaderboard] and recovery-leader already sits at col4.

AC-4 (round-trip count) cannot use a DB::listen counter - that never fires for the CH driver. The repo's actual idiom is pre-seeding exact cache keys and relying on .env.testing's ClickHouse-less pgsql bridge to throw on any stray real query (see HotlistCountTest.php). 'Before' is 0 (card does not exist); 'after' is the standard DashboardWidget cost, up to 13 monthly reads cold and cache-only thereafter - same shape as RecoveryCounts, so not a regression.
claims_to_corroborate.evidence_cited: HotlistCountTest.php approach; DashboardWidget::getMonthlyData() 13-month per-org cache-key loop

claims_to_corroborate.claim: MissedOpportunityClientGraph has ZERO test coverage anywhere in the repo today.

claims_to_corroborate.claim: MissedOpportunityFactory already has forOrg(Org) and deleted() states (the latter sets _peerdb_is_deleted=1), directly reusable for both new test files - no new factory states needed.

The cache key on MissedOpportunityClientGraph must be bumped (e.g. ':v2:') because the aggregate semantics change under an unchanged return shape - otherwise warm caches keep serving the old over-counted values.
HasProFeature page-level gating must NOT be used - RendersDashboardStat's own docblock forbids it on this per-card seam because it redirects the whole page rather than gating one card.

resource_envelope.trigger: New ClickHouse-backed aggregate on a Filament dashboard widget. No new App\Clickhouse\Queries\* class introduced, but it counts as a query trigger.

driving_tables.source: ticket text (measured by the closed reference implementation against production)

resource_envelope.growth: Not a batch-job growth question - a per-request widget render bounded per-org by the FIRST ORDER BY term. Row growth only enlarges one org's partition scan, which the sort key already prunes.
resource_envelope.allocation_sketch: Per render, cold cache: up to 13 monthly countDistinct(hotlist_id) queries scoped to one org's hotlist_org_id prefix, each far smaller than the full-YTD reference figure (44,642 read_rows / 1.6 MiB / 22.6 MiB peak / 12 ms for org 165, the largest group at 66% of the table). Warm cache: 0 round-trips. Concurrent renders pay the same small cache-amortized cost independently; no shared contention beyond normal CH Cloud pooling.

escalate.reason: One material unresolved design question with two structurally different valid answers (the expanded-detail wiring); two test-file breakages the ticket never mentions; a subtle Pennant guest TypeError trap where the reference impl appears to be backwards relative to the current test contract; first-ever Pro-gated card on a seam 9 sibling tickets will copy; one cosmetic build decision (the color) left open.
